title: ranunculus aquatilis var. baudotii
intro: Ranunculus aquatilis var. baudotii, commonly known as Yellow Water Crowfoot, is a flowering plant native to wetland areas in North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to aid in wound healing and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Yellow Water Crowfoot include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
